description: This source file defines the GatewayEndpointStore actor and supporting types and functions related to managing, configuring, and observing gateway endpoint states within the OpenClaw application. It handles configuration resolution, state management, remote tunnel ensuring, and URL generation for gateway dashboards.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointState
classes.description: An enum representing the current state of the gateway endpoint, including ready, connecting, and unavailable states with associated data.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointStore
classes.description: An actor responsible for managing and publishing the current gateway endpoint configuration and state. It provides methods for subscribing to state changes, refreshing configuration, setting modes, and ensuring remote control tunnels.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous stream of GatewayEndpointState updates, buffering the newest states.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the configuration and updates the state accordingly.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the connection mode to local, remote, or unconfigured and updates the state.

methods.name: ensureRemoteControlTunnel
methods.description: Ensures the remote control tunnel is established and returns the port number.

methods.name: requireConfig
methods.description: Returns the current gateway connection configuration or throws if unavailable.

methods.name: cancelRemoteEnsure
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing remote tunnel setup tasks.

methods.name: kickRemoteEnsureIfNeeded
methods.description: Triggers a remote tunnel setup if none is in progress.

methods.name: ensureRemoteConfig
methods.description: Ensures and returns the remote gateway configuration, establishing tunnels if necessary.

methods.name: requireRemoteMode
methods.description: Asserts that the current mode is remote, throws otherwise.

methods.name: resolveDirectRemoteURL
methods.description: Resolves the URL for direct remote connection if configured.

methods.name: maybeFallbackToTailnet
methods.description: Attempts to fallback to a tailnet host URL if local mode and environment conditions are met.
